jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience in technical product management at a technology company on a B2B, on-premise, highly technical product Very strong technical skills to understand and discuss modern architectural concepts, cloud/on-premise deployments, algorithms, APIs, and integration details Strong technical depth in at least one domain: high-performance computing and hardware-accelerated AI/ML workloads (GPUs, performance optimization, hardware-software tradeoffs), or platform/integration architecture (APIs, SDKs, system interoperability), or Linux-based product development/deployment (Linux ecosystem and installation trends)
